FORMAL_READING.CLAUSE_214_LOGIC: COMPLETE ONLY IF introduces necessary conditions; it does not state that the listed conditions are exhaustive or sufficient.
FORMAL_READING.CLAUSE_216_LOGIC: ANY CHANGE REOPEN applies to the closure-pinned world defined by clause [209]. Therefore a change in any pinned-world tuple component invalidates the current closure attempt even when that component is not repeated in the clause [214] list.
FORMAL_READING.CLAUSE_215_LOGIC: Expected-version CAS is necessary for authoritative fence mutation but is not the sole closure-safety predicate; pinned-world equality must be checked before the CAS.

POST_BARRIER_MEMBERSHIP_RULE.EFFECT: A post-barrier join may participate in closure/review/audit/read-only work. If it changes the current-epoch membership manifest or any drain manifest input, MEMBERSHIP_ROOT or DRAIN_ROOT changes and clause [216] requires REOPEN before COMPLETE.
POST_BARRIER_MEMBERSHIP_RULE.ALTERNATIVE_SAFE_ROUTING: A post-barrier join may be placed in a distinct audit-only generation/namespace that is explicitly excluded from the pinned current-epoch closure membership manifest, provided that exclusion itself is canonical and fixed before pinning.

REQUIRED_IMPLEMENTATION_INVARIANTS: Immediately before COMPLETE, recompute every component of the clause [209] pinned-world tuple from canonical current state.
Require exact equality of the recomputed tuple to the pinned tuple, including MEMBERSHIP_ROOT, DRAIN_ROOT, TEST_ENVIRONMENT_HASH, CONTROL_P0_ROOT, ENGINEERING_EPOCH, and CLOSURE_GENERATION.
If any tuple component differs, do not execute the COMPLETE CAS; transition/reopen closure and create a fresh closure generation/pinned world as required by clause [216].
Do not treat MISSION_FENCE_STATE.STATE_VERSION equality as a substitute for sharded membership/drain/root equality.
Persist the pinned tuple in authoritative closure state/evidence so two independent sweeps and the final CAS bind the same immutable values.
COUNTEREXAMPLE_DISPOSITION: The published counterexample succeeds only if clause [216] is interpreted as excluding changes to pinned components omitted from the clause [214] checklist. Under this candidate interpretation that premise is false: the post-pin membership change itself triggers REOPEN.
